hints.title: Removal Candidate Generation
hints.text: For each word, generate candidates by either keeping the word intact or removing exactly one character.

hints.title: Adjacent Pair Comparison
hints.text: Compare candidate variations of adjacent strings to find the length of their longest identical starting sequence.

hints.title: Global Maximum Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the maximum common prefix length observed across all adjacent string pairs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Candidate generation with single deletion and linear prefix comparison.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets of character deletions produces exponential variations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing L + 1 candidates per string requires minimal working memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generate single-deletion variants and compute maximum prefix length across adjacent pairs.
